Affine suffix-incidence hyperplanes force equal n-residue and count-residue for equivalent states. value.rationale: Natural exact Myhill–Nerode state invariant for all prime residue detectors of the first nontrivial repeated-letter subword patterns. The prime-power staircase and linear-in-r state compression are structural, not a finite-table increment.
